_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. config.json is gitignored (holds the token + DB creds).

sql.query:
-- Item-wise stock across all locations. Replace with the real query once schema discovery / your BUSY vendor confirms table + column names. It must RETURN one row per SKU per store with the columns named in columnMap below. Example shape:
-- SELECT ItemCode, ItemName, Company AS Brand, Category, Location, SalePrice, MRP, ClosingQty FROM <busy_stock_view>;

csv._comment: Only used when mode='csv'. Point at a fixed file, OR set pickNewestIn+filter to auto-pick the newest BUSY export in a folder.

columnMap._comment: LEFT = LIQO field, RIGHT = the exact column name in your SQL result / CSV header. sku+store+category+brand+price+stockQty are the minimum.
columnMap.name: ItemName

categoryMap._comment: Map BUSY category/group text (any case) to the 4 engine categories. Rows in other categories are skipped.

storeMap._comment: Map BUSY location/branch/godown text (any case) to LIQO store slugs. Unmatched locations are auto-slugged.
